description: This file defines a PHP class EchoSqlLogger that implements the Doctrine DBAL SQLLogger interface. It is used to log SQL queries, including query strings, parameters, and types, primarily for debugging or development purposes.

classes.name: EchoSqlLogger
classes.description: A logger class that outputs SQL query details to the standard output, including the query string, parameters, and types for debugging purposes.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger, optionally enabling replace behavior.

methods.description: Logs the SQL query, parameters, and types when a query starts execution.
